named_limitations: Decode is device-bound on every profile. p150 B32 device time is 2.5% above end-to-end; profiled replays rise from 9017 to 9776 us over 4 replays (profiler overhead or data-dependent dispatch; not separated).
B1 reaches 16% (p150x4) to 36% (p150) of the DRAM roofline: many small ops per step.
Layer costs include each layer's MoE. At B32 a GDN-type layer costs 1.28x (p150x4), 1.54x (p150x2), 3.36x (p150) a full-type layer.
p150 B32 GDN-type layer 6612 us: GDN runs per row on p150 because the batched GDN kernel needs 128 cores; MoE uses EP dispatch at 32 rows.
B32 MoE slot path reads each selected expert once per row slot; no device-side de-duplication of the expert union.
Sampler trace is 5.5% (p150x4), 7.3% (p150x2), 8.2% (p150) of B1 token-out; not dominant.
